identity.region: mid-lumbar spinal dorsal horn, lamina II
identity.interpretation: GRP-positive lamina-II excitatory interneuron used as a biologically informed transient-central/eTrC-like model
identity.warning: GRP identity is supported; exact eTrC membership and same-cell electrophysiology are not established for NMO_109005.

temperature_claim: 35°C temperature-translated model prediction constrained by room-temperature GRP population electrophysiology

passive.provenance: bounded fit to Dickie et al. GRP population RMP and Rin; capacitance mismatch preserved

active_domain.label: MODEL-DEFINED PROXIMAL ACTIVE CHANNEL DOMAIN
active_domain.description: soma plus native axon segments at path distance <=20 µm from soma; no synthetic geometry

active_mechanisms.source: Medlock/ModelDB 267056 mechanism; kinetics attributed in source comments to dorsal-horn sodium-current models
active_mechanisms.biological_evidence: fast Na current is required for action-potential initiation; density is fitted, not measured in this cell
active_mechanisms.reason_retained: required for stable, overshooting action potentials
active_mechanisms.temperature_handling: MOD computes tadj with Q10=3 relative to 23°C, but gate tau uses tau_factor instead; audited kinetics are effectively temperature-independent.

active_mechanisms.source: Medlock/ModelDB 267056 mechanism; source cites Safronov et al. 2000
active_mechanisms.biological_evidence: delayed-rectifier K current is required for repolarization; density is fitted, not measured in this cell
active_mechanisms.reason_retained: prevents runaway excitation and supports stable recovery
active_mechanisms.temperature_handling: MOD computes a Q10=3 tadj relative to 23°C but does not apply it to rates; audited kinetics are effectively temperature-independent.

discretization.policy: odd nseg by d-lambda, with finer proximal native axon sampling

status_reason: Morphology, passive RMP/Rin, rheobase, single-spike stability, recovery, and numerical execution are established; capacitance, active-model Rin, and first-spike latency do not match population constraints.
